item.title: 2026 Beanpot Preview: Could a Win Put One of These Teams’ Seasons Back on Track?
item.description: In what has been an arguably underwhelming year for all four squads, securing the coveted Beanpot title could alter the trajectory of any of their seasons. Heights editors take a look at where each team stands as the push for the postseason begins in earnest.

item.title: It Starts Now: Beanpot Beginning of Big Second Half for No. 12 BC
item.description: Although the Eagles came out with a slower-than-expected start, to be frank, so did the rest of Hockey East. And it seems BC is heating just at the right time, as the Beanpot is up for grabs among the four Boston schools.

item.title: A Night of Folk With Dean Johnson Leaves Audience in Reflection
item.description: This was the charm of Dean Johnson, who, soft-spoken and rocking his usual beanie, performed Thursday night at The Sinclair in Cambridge. Doors opened at 7:00 p.m., but people were eagerly lining up beforehand, ready to enjoy an indie-folk night that felt more like a gathering between friends than a concert.

item.title: “20 Years Ago, This Wouldn’t Have Happened”: The Women’s Beanpot Is Bigger Than Boston.
item.description: The Beanpot has always been a chance to play for something bigger than a regular-season win—something that didn’t really exist until 2000, when the NCAA started holding women’s national championships. Now, the tournament is ultra-competitive—a pattern that is emerging throughout the country, not just in greater Boston.

item.title: The Best Boston Restaurants for Galentine’s Dinner
item.description: With Valentine’s Day right around the corner, you might be planning a date for that “special someone.” But even if that’s not applicable this year, a Galentine’s dinner is always a great option.

item.title: Eagles’ Strong Start Leads to 5–4 OT Win Over Maine
item.description: Entering 3-on-3 play in overtime, both parties were fighting tooth and nail for the win. Murphy, Thomas, and Taber kept primary control over the puck to open the sequence, and Taber ended it for a BC 5–4 win.

item.title: Newton Land Use Committee Approves Minor Changes to Assisted Living Facility
item.description: Newton’s Land Use Committee approved minor changes to an assisted living facility’s design on Tuesday evening, maintaining compliance with the project's existing special permit.

item.title: BC Loses 70–60 to Georgia Tech, Falls to 0–11 in ACC Play
item.description: Boston College women's basketball scored five points in the first quarter to the Yellow Jackets’ 17, as Georgia Tech ran away with a 70–60 win over BC.
